caption:
Everyone tells you to buy more bins. That is not why your cabinet stays messy.

Containers don't fix it. Bigger cabinets don't fix it. The problem is depth — when you can't reach the back without pulling everything in front out first, the back row stops existing.

A sliding basket organizer fixes the depth problem. Simple Houseware's chrome 2-tier model holds 18 lbs per shelf, and each tier pulls forward independently, so the back row is one motion away.

Nothing stays buried at the back, so you stop buying duplicates of things already in the cabinet. It becomes a system instead of a graveyard.
